scope: Exact quick-xml tokenizer dependency for the existing source UI presentation consumer

package.name: quick-xml
package.normal_dependency: Existing memchr, with no optional features or build script

consumer_contract: Use bounded already-admitted source bytes through Reader::from_reader(slice) or from_str; do not let the tokenizer open files.
Preserve raw source spans, ordered attributes/text/entity references, include declarations and unknown UI operators. GeneralRef is a source observation, not an instruction to resolve a custom entity.
Do not execute or fetch DTD/external entities. Preserve DocType as source data or explicitly refuse it; do not supply an entity resolver or derive runtime traits/defaults from unresolved source.
Charge source bytes, depth, events, retained raw/string bytes and output before copying. Preserve whitespace instead of global trimming; unavailable encodings or malformed input refuse explicitly.
Source UI structure is separate from original tile evaluation, fonts, input navigation and gameplay acceptance.
source_review: Packaged manifests, MIT notice, VCS metadata and entire slice-reader implementation read; API documentation reviewed. No full transitive per-file or retail UI evaluation audit claimed.
